svg.title: Event pipeline on Google Cloud
svg.desc:
Event pipeline on Google Cloud Order events go from Pub/Sub through Cloud Run into storage, a warehouse and a forecast model. Solid lines: events and data.
Blocks, left to right: - Order events (Pub/Sub) - Event processor (Cloud Run) - Address check (Cloud Functions) - Raw events (Cloud Storage) - Orders warehouse (BigQuery) - Demand forecast (Vertex AI) Groups: - 01 Ingest: Order events - 02 Process: Event processor, Address check - 03 Store: Raw events, Orders warehouse - 04 Predict: Demand forecast - Google Cloud project (Networking and access rules left out): Order events, Event processor, Address check, Raw events, Orders warehouse, Demand forecast Lines: - Order events -> Event processor, labeled "push" - Event processor -> Address check, labeled "address" - Event processor -> Raw events, labeled "JSON" - Address check -> Orders warehouse, labeled "rows" - Orders warehouse -> Demand forecast, labeled "training data" Note: Fictional workload. No deployed resources Replace the labels; keep each service name under its icon
